items.name: Bloody Yukata
items.description: A white kimono with dark crimson stains on the sleeve. The fabric is torn near the hem.

items.name: Rusted Katana
items.description: An old samurai sword covered in rust. The handle wrapping has come loose.

items.name: Ryū Dragon
items.description: A carved Eastern dragon. In Japanese myth the ryū commands the rain and brings good fortune.

items.name: Torn Paper Fan
items.description: A decorative fan with cherry blossom patterns. Several ribs are broken.

items.name: Straw Sugegasa
items.description: A traveler's woven straw hat. The brim is frayed and stained with rain.

items.name: Folded Crane
items.description: A delicate paper crane with a faded ink mark on one wing.

items.name: Norigae
items.description: An ornamental tassel that Korean women tie to their hanbok for beauty and good luck.

items.name: Maple Syrup
items.description: A tin of maple syrup, boiled from the sap of autumn maples — a North American staple.

items.name: Tuk-Tuk
items.description: A toy tuk-tuk, the three-wheeled auto rickshaw that buzzes through the streets of Thailand.

items.name: Boomerang
items.description: A returning boomerang, a hunting and sporting tool crafted by Aboriginal Australians for millennia.

items.name: Sphinx Statue
items.description: A small sphinx — the lion-bodied, human-headed guardian of ancient Egyptian tombs.

items.name: Turban
items.description: A length of cloth wound into a turban, worn across the deserts of the Middle East and South Asia.

items.name: Crucifix
items.description: An ornate crucifix, the Christian cross found in the chapels of medieval European castles.

items.name: Kris Dagger
items.description: A kris, the wavy-bladed dagger of Indonesia, prized as both weapon and spiritual heirloom.

items.name: Jeweled Chalice
items.description: A ceremonial goblet set with gemstones, locked away in the dungeon vaults.

items.name: Gold Coin
items.description: A tarnished gold coin stamped with the crest of a long-forgotten kingdom.

items.name: Skull
items.description: A weathered skull, a grim relic left to gather dust in the dungeon depths.

items.name: Ganesha
items.description: A statue of Ganesha, the elephant-headed Hindu deity who clears away obstacles.

items.name: Salakot
items.description: A salakot, the lightweight woven sun hat traditional to the Philippines and nearby isles.

items.name: Kulintang
items.description: A kulintang, a row of small bronze gongs played across the southern Philippines and Borneo.
